title: Crestline Companion Reinstatement Fee on Voluntary Cancellations: Payment Reference
content:
A trip returned to a certificate or pass by a voluntary cancellation carries a reinstatement fee, which the holder pays in person as its own charge entry of component reinstatement fee on the ledger of that certificate or pass, naming the companion ticket of the cancelled booking. This applies to every product of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes.

The reinstatement fee for a voluntary cancellation is not fixed until the certificate's ledger carries the refund of the cancelled booking's taxes and fees. While the trip and charge history of the certificate or pass does not yet show that refund, the fee is not fixed.

## Capability

`pay_companion_reinstatement_fee_0c05ba56` lets the holder pay, in person, the reinstatement fee of a companion booking that was cancelled and whose companion trip came back to the certificate or pass. One run records one paid charge of component reinstatement fee, dated today, on that certificate's or pass's charge history, linked to the companion ticket of the cancelled booking; the holder's companion charges rise by the amount paid, and the holder sees the fee as paid.

## How it is invoked

This is the holder's own tool. The agent unlocks `pay_companion_reinstatement_fee_0c05ba56` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to make the payment; the agent does not run it on the holder's behalf.

## Parameters

- `companion_id` — reference number of the companion certificate or pass record the fee is paid on, as returned by the companion certificate and pass lookup.
- `companion_ticket_number` — the companion's ticket number on the cancelled booking: 13 digits beginning 419, digits only with no spaces, exactly as shown on that booking's entry in the companion trip and charge history.
- `amount` — the reinstatement fee being paid, in USD, a decimal number rounded to 2 decimal places (cents), rounding half up; never negative.

## Return

A receipt confirming the payment: `charge_entry_id` (reference of the new paid charge), `companion_id`, `companion_ticket_number` (the 13-digit ticket the fee relates to), `charge_component` (always `reinstatement_fee`), `amount_usd` (USD with 2 decimal places), `entry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today's business date) and `status` (`payment_recorded` when the payment is on file). No error receipt is defined.
